step_template_text: First pick what you are designing for – Battle Pass, Gear Chip and more. Size and cut line adjust automatically. On a phone the templates are in the “{tab}” tab.
step_add_text: Use “{image}” to upload a photo or logo; next to it you add text, stickers and fills. Move, rotate and resize right on the label.
step_print_text: Everything is saved automatically in “{library}”. Open it to set quantities and create the print sheet as a PDF. “{export}” gives you a single PNG or the cut line as SVG.
